script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The text says the disciples were perplexed; it does not say nobody made that remark.
The text says Peter motioned to the disciple, not that he said nothing or communicated entirely through hand signals across the table.
The passage does not establish that nobody at the table was acting as a guard.
Saying he would have needed a spotlight and drumroll casts Papa Dorin in Jesus' role of identifying the betrayer.
The text says no one at the table knew why Jesus spoke to Judas. It does not say that no one in the room understood.
The text does not establish that nobody at the table was thinking about rent.
The passage gives what some thought; it does not say nobody guessed anything about hiding the bag.
Judas left, but the text does not say nobody at the table sat back down.
The slow-cooker joke makes God's glorification of the Son the subject of the joke.
The imagined line casts Papa Dorin in Jesus' role and invents words in that role.
The passage does not mention a prophet here, but it does not establish that no prophet was mentioned at the table.
The passage does not record anyone asking who will lead, but it does not establish that nobody at the table brought it up.
Peter asks another question, but the text does not say whether he accepted Jesus' answer.
The passage does not say Peter spoke in one breath.
